# Stereogram

> A free stereogram (Magic Eye) generator that runs entirely in the browser. Pick a shape, type a
> word, paint a relief or upload a depth map; choose random dots or a pattern; download a PNG at
> screen, phone-wallpaper or A4 print size. English interface. No account, no ads, nothing is
> uploaded, and the page works offline once loaded.

## What it is
- Single-image stereograms (autostereograms) after Thimbleby, Inglis & Witten (IEEE Computer, 1994), with hidden-surface removal, parallel or cross-eyed viewing, adjustable eye separation and depth of field.
- Depth sources: eight built-in shapes, hidden text, a soft-brush drawing, or any greyscale picture (white = near).
- Patterns: black-and-white random dots with adjustable density, colour dots, three procedural tiles, or a picture of your own.
- Reproducible: a seed and a shareable link recreate the same picture pixel for pixel.
- Open source, MIT.

## How to use it
- https://stereogram.dravec.org/ — make one; the first picture appears without any input.
- https://stereogram.dravec.org/?text=HELLO — a link with parameters opens that exact picture (shape, text, seed, size, pattern, depth, mode).
- https://stereogram.dravec.org/#/see — how to see a stereogram, including the honest note that about one person in twenty cannot.

## Data & provenance
- No data set. All rendering is deterministic code in the page; nothing leaves the browser except anonymous first-party usage counts (no cookies).
